name: Garry Tonon Leg Lock to Back System
description: Garry Tonon’s Shoot To Kill: Wrestle, Scramble, Submit covers wrestling setups, back access, ashi entries, front headlocks and scrambles.
summary: Wrestling entries developed into takedowns, back attacks and submissions during scrambles.
overview: Shoot To Kill: Wrestle, Scramble, Submit covers Garry Tonon’s connections between wrestling and submission grappling. Singles, doubles and body locks sit alongside leg entanglements, front-headlock attacks and scrambling positions. Back takes and leg locks are part of this broader curriculum, which also includes demonstrations through drills and rolling footage.

products.title: Shoot To Kill: Wrestle, Scramble, Submit

products.best_for: Submission grapplers looking to connect their wrestling and ground offense.

guide.display_title: Garry Tonon: Wrestling, Scrambles and Submissions

fits: You want submission opportunities connected to wrestling exchanges.
You want material on singles, doubles and body locks as well as what follows them.
consider_alternative_if: You need a course devoted solely to leg-lock finishing details.

includes: Wrestling posture and setups, singles, doubles, trips and body-lock returns.
Ashi entries, front-headlock attacks, kimuras and back takes from wrestling situations.
Scramble rolls, drills and rolling footage.
limits: Its eight volumes span standing exchanges and multiple submission families; leg-lock-to-back transitions are only part of the course.
